gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules count the sale of assets as Local receipts, while the governmental funds statement (p5) prints 'Sale of assets' under other financing sources (General 3,971 + Road 119,728 = Total 123,699, p5-6) and not in total receipts 10,500,901. General Fund budget schedule (p10) Local 1,279,121 = combining General Fund column Local 1,275,150 (p7) + 3,971; Road Fund budget schedule (p12) Local 147,348 = statement Road Local 27,620 (p5) + 119,728. Detail takes both funds' receipts from the budget schedules as printed: 3,971 + 119,728 = 123,699 = 10,624,600 - 10,500,901. No line is missing or duplicated.

Statement p5-6 Transfers - in: Road 1,000,000 + Road and Bridge 500,000 = 1,500,000; the General Fund column nets the General Fund sub-fund transfers (in 0, out (1,000,000)). The combining General Fund statement (p7) prints them gross: Self-Health Insurance Fund 147,141 + Noxious Weed Fund 53,050 = 200,191 in, General transfers out (1,200,191). Detail (gross per fund): 147,141 + 53,050 + 1,000,000 + 500,000 = 1,700,191 = 1,500,000 + 200,191. Only the statement's netting of intra-General-Fund transfers.

Statement p5 Transfers - out: General (1,000,000) + Road (500,000) = (1,500,000). Detail: General Fund transfers out (1,200,191) (budget schedule p11 = combining p7, gross incl. 200,191 to its Self-Health Insurance and Noxious Weed sub-funds) + Road (500,000) (p12) = 1,700,191; difference 200,191 = the sub-fund transfers in. No fix.
